newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S. Africa's Standard Bank appoints equities head. [CORRECTED 00:50 GMT 18/12]
newsitem.headline: S. Africa's Standard Bank appoints equities head. [CORRECTED 00:50 GMT 18/12]

text.p: South Africa's Standard Bank group on Monday announced the appointment of former Fergusson Brothers director Peter Jardine as head of the bank's stockbroking arm, Standard Equities.
The bank said Jardine would join Standard Corporate and Merchant Bank as director, Standard Equities on January 13. (Corrects to show Mr Jardine has not been appointed as managing director.)
"With the resources of the Standard Bank group, Standard Equities will become a major player in the South African and African equities market," Jardine said in a statement.
Current Standard Equities managing director Winston Roux would become deputy to Standard Equities chairman Div Geeringh.
